response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, CAST(SUM(derived_product_cost) AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), avg_r AS (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv) SELECT inv.invoice_number, inv.cost_ratio, inv.line_item_count, inv.cost_ratio / NULLIF(avg_r.avg_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM inv CROSS JOIN avg_r WHERE avg_r.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (inv.cost_ratio / NULLIF(avg_r.avg_ratio, 0)) IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
